summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Branch Auto-Assignment feature. All tests pass: 1) Branch selection card is NOT visible on /order page - verified via UI test, 2) Menu items load correctly without manual branch selection, 3) GET /api/nearest-branch endpoint returns correct nearest branch based on GPS coordinates, 4) POST /api/orders with null branch_id auto-assigns nearest branch based on user_latitude/user_longitude, 5) Checkout page does NOT display branch name in order summary, 6) End-to-end order flow works (add to cart → checkout → place order → tracking).
critical_code_review_comments: LandingPage.js: Branch selection card successfully removed - only Order Type (Takeaway/Delivery) visible
LandingPage.js: Geolocation runs silently on page load, auto-detects nearest branch
LandingPage.js: userLocation state passed to checkout page for backend auto-assignment
CheckoutPage.js: Branch name NOT displayed in Order Summary - only shows Order Type, Items count, item details, and totals
CheckoutPage.js: Sends user_latitude/user_longitude in order data when branch_id is null
server.py: haversine_distance() helper correctly calculates distance between coordinates
server.py: find_nearest_branch() helper returns nearest active branch
server.py: GET /api/nearest-branch returns branch and distance_km
server.py: POST /api/orders auto-assigns branch via coordinates or falls back to first active branch
seed_data_creation: Test orders created with TEST_ prefix (TEST_Auto_Assignment_User, TEST_Auto_Near_Old_Hubli, TEST_E2E_Order, etc.)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Branch Auto-Assignment feature fully implemented and tested: 1) GET /api/nearest-branch?latitude=X&longitude=Y returns nearest branch with distance, 2) POST /api/orders accepts optional branch_id with user_latitude/user_longitude for auto-assignment, 3) LandingPage.js hides branch selection, auto-detects location silently, passes userLocation to checkout, 4) CheckoutPage.js sends coordinates in order data and doesn't display branch name. Two branches: Old Hubli (ff0061fe-8e0c-4a6f-b44c-522597e9e959) and Shirur Park (c2d594c8-f358-4b0c-8aea-6bbe800b2340).

branch_selection_hidden.details: Branch selection card NOT visible on /order page. Only Order Type (Takeaway/Delivery) tabs visible. No 'select branch', 'choose location' text found.

menu_loads_without_branch_selection.details: 14 menu categories and menu items load correctly on /order page without manual branch selection. Items display in accordion format.

nearest_branch_endpoint.details: GET /api/nearest-branch returns correct branch: coordinates near Old Hubli (15.36, 75.13) return Old Hubli branch, coordinates near Shirur Park (15.35, 75.14) return Shirur Park branch. Distance_km included in response.

order_auto_assignment.details: POST /api/orders with branch_id=null and user_latitude/user_longitude correctly auto-assigns nearest branch. Tested for both branches. Fallback to first active branch works when no coordinates provided.

order_explicit_branch.details: POST /api/orders with explicit branch_id still works correctly.

checkout_no_branch_name.details: Checkout page Order Summary shows only: Order Type, Items count, item names/prices, Subtotal, GST, Total. Branch name NOT displayed.

e2e_order_flow.details: Complete flow works: /order → add item to cart → cart summary → checkout → fill details → place order → order tracking page. Order #ALT000009 created successfully.

order_tracking_no_branch.details: Order tracking page shows Customer name, Phone, Order Type, Total Amount. Branch name NOT displayed to customer.
